variants.name: Перламутровый собор
variants.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE whole wide landscape scene, polished game concept art for Roblox Ball Ocean Depths, PEARL GROTTO. Reference image 1 is only camera/lane scale/toy-brick art direction; replace its kelp landscape with pearlescent underwater cave. Elevated three-quarter view, long straight generously WIDE football lane from large lower foreground to far upper right, uninterrupted pale cream and soft sand checker surface with orderly small square studs, thin pale game markings, cyan-turquoise edges. Central corridor AND entire flight airspace above remain empty: no shells/cave ribs/rocks protruding over route. Cave roof very high beyond visible gameplay corridor. HUGE OPEN CLAMSHELL behind the END of lane as a distant finale landmark, visibly open valves and a bright pearl clearly visible in bowl. Shell fully supported on broad visible solid rocky/sandy dais beyond playing plane, its lower lip cannot intrude onto field. The pearl illuminates pearlescent cave. Toy-brick handmade faceted 3D, large clean readable shapes, carefully applied studs on building surfaces, pearlescent shell ribs geometric and attractive, softly iridescent cream mother-of-pearl, mint/cyan/light pink, blue shadows. All grounded objects fully supported across their complete footprint. Underwater haze and small bubbles, polished delightful family-friendly beauty, no photoreal scans, no text/logo/UI/collage, no characters. Distinct composition A: a tall soaring grotto like an organic cathedral, enormous cream and icy mint vertical shell-rib rock pillars rooted in broad layered blue side terraces, generous open central volume. Distant giant symmetrical fan-shaped white clam shell rises as upright scalloped halo around luminous pearl behind lane end. Soft bright pearl-white main light from final landmark, cool cyan secondary light from high clefts, tiny rose coral fans grounded on side terraces. Palette pearl ivory, icy mint, turquoise, blue-violet shadows with discreet blush. Clearly enclosed high cave above and behind, no visible sea surface. Preserve long lane depth and open overhead corridor.
variants.description: Высокие перламутровые рёбра образуют соборный грот; по бокам синие террасы, розовые кораллы, радужные кристаллы и малые раковины. Огромная раскрытая раковина с яркой жемчужиной возвышается на отдельном пьедестале за концом трассы.
